design.model: Within taxon-sex centred log organ lengths regressed on within taxon-sex centred log candidate size proxy
design.bootstrap: 4,000 paired-plant bootstrap draws separately within fixed sex-species strata, NumPy default_rng(20261008)
design.unit: Each plant is the repeated paired-organ sample; site and phylogenetic histories not independently resampled

size_proxies.meaning: Combined lengths of 3 upper leaves (may biologically overlap leaf size measurement)
Terminal capitulum-to-third-leaf distance, a stem architecture proxy, not whole-plant biomass
Count of heads; log1p-transformed; reproductive allocation proxy, not pure vegetative size

biological_result: Matched leaf dimensions associate more strongly with leaf- and stem-derived growth proxies than do reproductive involucre or corolla dimensions; within these strata the latter have very weak regressions on measured proxies. Between-organ relative CV gradient cannot be explained as identical allometric dependence; residual biological reason unresolved.
inference_limits: Size proxies are not experimentally manipulated environment or nutrition; correlation and slopes cannot identify plasticity or developmental canalization
Upper-3 leaf predictor shares vegetative organ character with middle-leaf response, causing expected structural association
Small group n=10 female strata and geographic/stage heterogeneity are not population-level replication
We do not estimate selection gradients, evolutionary rates, heritability, pollen contact or achene fitness; no Nature-level mechanism established
Current Azami GEB submission is frozen; this is independent aza3 successor research
